title.en: An Act to Authorize the Segregation of the Municipality of Concepcion, on the Island of Maestre De Campo From the Province of Romblon, and Its Annexation to the Province of Mindoro. and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The Secretary of the Interior is hereby em- powered, whenever the public, interest may demand
it, to segregate the municipality of Concepcion, on the Island of Maestre de Campo, from the Province of
Romblon, to which it at present belongs, and annex it to the Province of Mindoro.

The municipality of Concepcion, the segregation whereof is authorized by this Act, shall have
the same' territory and boundaries as it has at present.
All acts or parts of acts inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect in accordance with the provisions of section eleven of the
Administrative Code.
Approved, March 6, 1924.
